You can enable the hints for the tuning prims under the affix config. Also it's possible to set up a hotkey under settings to toggle the feature on/off.

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/josdemmers/Diablo4Companion/refs/heads/master/readme/wiki-tuning-prism-001.png" height="300">

With the tuning prism hints enabled each affix is marked with a color matching the tuning prism to quickly see which one is required.

- Aggressive Tuning Prism (red)
- Protector's Tuning Prism (blue)
- Resourceful Tuning Prism (Green)
- Pragmatic Tuning Prism (Purple)
- Chromatic Tuning Prism (Lightblue)
- Adept's Tuning Prism (Yellow)

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/josdemmers/Diablo4Companion/refs/heads/master/readme/wiki-tuning-prism-002.png" height="300">
